instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, elbows bent, palms facing forward.
3. Press both dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended over your chest.
4. Lower the dumbbells under control until your elbows reach chest level.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your feet locked under the pads to stay stable.
2. Lower the dumbbells slowly and keep the press controlled.
3. Drive through your chest, not your shoulders.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press

instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing each other, with a slight bend in your elbows.
3. Open your arms in a wide arc, lowering the dumbbells out to your sides until you feel a stretch across your chest.
4. Bring the dumbbells back up in the same arc until they meet above your chest.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep a fixed slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
2. Squeeze your chest at the top of the arc.
3. Control the lowering phase and do not overstretch.
4. Exhale as you raise, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell decline fly

instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand by your sides, palms facing each other.
3. Press the dumbbells up over your chest until your arms are fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbells under control back to your sides.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your palms facing each other the whole time.
2. Tuck your elbows close to your body to load the triceps and lower chest.
3. Control the lowering phase.
4. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Decline Hammer Press

instructions:
1. Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads.
2. Hold a dumbbell in one hand by your side, palm facing in, and grip the bench with your free hand.
3. Press the dumbbell up over your chest until your arm is fully extended.
4. Lower the dumbbell under control back to your side.
5. Switch arms and repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core to stop your torso from twisting toward the loaded side.
2. Keep your palm facing in and elbow close to your body.
3. Hold the bench firmly with your free hand for balance.
4. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Decline One Arm Hammer Press

instructions:
1. Lie back on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads.
2. Hold a dumbbell in both hands with your arms extended overhead.
3. Curl your torso up, keeping the dumbbell extended above your head, until you are sitting upright.
4. Lower your torso back down under control to the start.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your neck neutral and do not pull with it.
2. Move with your abs, not momentum.
3. Keep your arms straight overhead throughout.
4. Exhale as you sit up, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Decline Overhead Sit-up
